title: ひな祭りのイラスト
subject_en: Hinamatsuri (Japanese doll festival, March 3rd) objects and dolls, each a separate object, kawaii soft style in pink, cream, red and gold. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (faces, rice, sake) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: おひなさまとおだいりさま、三人官女、ぼんぼり、ひしもち、ひなあられ、桃の花。3月のおたより、園の掲示、ひな祭りのカードに使える12点。
items: a cute empress doll in a layered red and pink kimono with a small gold crown
a cute emperor doll in a dark blue kimono holding a thin wooden tablet, with a tall black hat
おひなさまとおだいりさま
the empress and emperor dolls sitting side by side on a small red platform
three small court-lady dolls in red and white, standing in a row

a small bowl of colourful round rice crackers in pink, cream and green
